outline: 本課程介紹整數規劃問題相關的數學模式、演算法及相關應用，包含模式的觀念、方法、數理基礎與分析。包含旅行者問題、有效不等式、與分支定界演算法等。
schedule:
Week1~2. Introduction to Linear Programming Models
Week3~5. Building Integer Programming Models
Week6~8. Modeling Combinatorial Optimization Problems
Week10~12. Preprocessing for Better Formulation
Week13~16. Integer Programming Algorithms
Week17. Applications of Integer Programming Models
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

Der-San Chen, Robert G. Batson, Yu Dang (2010), Applied Integer Programming : Modeling and Solution, John Wiley & Sons, Hoboken, New Jersey
